Defendant fails to comply with judgment, refuses to report assets, execution notice, fine of 5000 yuan, still not comply, later fulfills obligations. This is about refusal to execute civil judgment. The fine of 5000 yuan is a penalty, but the criminal charge is that. So answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定罪<eoa>. Possibly also "妨害执行" but the standard term is "拒不执行判决、裁定罪". So single charge.
